scope: Actual-font overlay and standalone native/169mm visual inspection only; no final book-page claim.

proof.limitation: A scaled raster proof was actually viewed. Final PDF placement remains for the integrating agent.

visual_checks.category_identity_and_selected_row: Category c is in its input box; c=3 is placed adjacent to the highlighted third table row and its outgoing lookup arrow.
visual_checks.table_shape: K by d_e is shown above the row table; the actual background shows 6 rows and 4 columns.
visual_checks.embedding_vector: The 4 blue coordinate cells are labelled embedding e_c, d_e dimensions. Their horizontal drawing is not claimed to be the mathematical orientation.
visual_checks.numerical_branch: The 2 green cells are labelled numerical x, r dimensions; the route enters the lower green concatenation cells.
visual_checks.concatenation: The output is labelled v=[e_c;x], r+d_e dimensions; upper blue and lower green cells express concatenation, with no plus/sum operator.
visual_checks.network: The six input units, four ReLU hidden units and single raw score are distinct from the following Sigmoid module and scalar probability p.
visual_checks.label_positions: Names and their short variables share a baseline. Labels avoid arrows, matrix borders and node circles, except the intended variables centered inside the category, score and probability nodes.
visual_checks.target_size: The 169mm proof retains readable main labels and real subscripts. Nested superscript dimensions were replaced with flat dimension labels to improve small-size readability.

handoff_caption_requirements: The horizontal small cells depict coordinates of the mathematical column vector e_c.
The displayed grid/unit counts are a schematic configuration; the third selected table row corresponds to c=3.
Biases and other details not separately drawn are covered by the formal classifier equation.
